searchText: Hey fellow learners 👋 . I'm a protocol dev at Obol Network. I wish to work on MEV+CL software (https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-three/blob/master/projects/project-ideas.md#cl--mev-software). How do I connect with people working on it? <@914307919699406908> <@686695036733227017> <@539495253418180618> 🙏 hello <@783977469077094421> , you can dm me and we can start to work on a project First step would be diving into the area, learning about underlying infrastructure and current solutions, then submitting your dev update about it. Check the program guides here https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-three/tree/master/program-guide Hi, I have a question regarding notation on EIPs. I saw the use of the `//` symbol on math formulas, and was not sure what's the interpretation Integer division: ``` 5 / 2 = 2.5 5 // 2 = 2 ``` Nice, thank you for the clarification I'm also collecting EVM benchmarks ideas in https://github.com/ipsilon/evm-benchmarks. If someone wants a short break you can convert an idea into a proper benchmark.
